title: TRAM: Benchmarking Temporal Reasoning for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Manual error analysis of incorrect model predictions in foundational temporal understanding tasks to quantify instances where models over-rely on typical patterns from their training data, neglecting cultural or individual variations in temporal concepts.

Manual error analysis of model mistakes in advanced temporal reasoning tasks to identify when models overly depend on familiar story patterns, prioritizing recognized sequences over fresh contextual interpretations.
